title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil pasta. Fry pancetta. Whisk eggs and cheese. Combine all with pasta water.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken. Grill it. Simmer in tomato sauce and spices. Add cream.

title: Garden Salad
summary: A fresh mix of seasonal greens and a light vinaigrette.
instructions: Chop vegetables. Mix in a bowl. Drizzle with oil and lemon juice.
